findings.title: Door dust is smaller than the required handle scale and barely reads on the page
findings.criterion: A8: 3-5 faint lavender-grey motes, each between the door gold handle's size and twice it; dust must read as coming from behind the door at7x5in.
findings.observed: Four plain wisps are present, with no forbidden curls/face, but appear as tiny low smudges. Approximate visual bounds mapped from the1668x943native crop to the620x350source window are30-55source px wide and10-20high per wisp, versus roughly70x35for the original gold handle. The full-page proof does not supply a sufficiently readable non-reader clue.
findings.measurement_limit: Approximate visually located bounds, not a claimed automated segmentation. The size shortfall is large enough to see directly at native and whole-page scale.
findings.required_correction: Enlarge the individual dust footprints to1-2times the handle's source size, keeping faint irregular plain dust, gaps, closed-door staging, no spiral/face, complete contour and no patch seam. Record actual source bounds and inspect both100%and7x5-equivalent views. Rebuild/rerun caption, scope and export gates; replace A8DONE claim only after review.

findings.title: Rebuild helper can manufacture fresh visual acceptance for an unreviewed PDF
findings.criterion: DL-AUTH-06/07: exact validation evidence and visual acceptance must remain distinct from mechanical regeneration; README says a changed PDF requires fresh visual review.
findings.observed: At the reviewed revision record_review.py computes the current PDF/email hashes then unconditionally writes five hard-coded PASS_WITH_DECLARED_A9_HOLD observations, with zero remaining defects. It can stamp old observations onto any replaced or uninspected PDF, defeating the verifier's hash binding.
findings.required_correction: Make existing visual reviews immutable evidence. A helper may validate the reviewed target hashes and fail on mismatch; it must not auto-approve or rebind old observations. New candidate hashes require new actually performed visual passes, recorded separately and reviewed.

findings.title: Local validation reports tests that it does not run and can overwrite the impact's historical evidence
findings.criterion: DL-AUTH-06 requires actual command results and exact changed-path evidence; failed or pending checks cannot become an aggregate pass.
findings.observed: The baseline helper hard-codes '52 passed' without running unittest, sets top-level PASS regardless of the copied book_gate status, and rewrites the impact record using only current dirty paths with hard-coded prior passes. Re-running it from a clean published checkout can erase historical coverage and misstate checks.
findings.required_correction: Execute requested gates and capture command/return code/output; derive aggregate status from actual current checks and propagate failure. Without rerunning, label those checks not executed and preserve sealed prior receipts. Do not rewrite published impact history merely from current working-tree dirt.

findings.title: Reveal diagnostic is a sparse facing-spread board rather than a clearly labelled turn comparison
findings.criterion: Delivery should make the actual binding/reveal order inspectable; do not misrepresent facing pages as a turn.
findings.observed: The board includes8-9,10-11,12-13,14-15,22-23,24-25,26-27,28-29, with252x180thumbnails inside widely spaced672pxcolumns. It indirectly provides before/after spreads but does not explicitly label13→14/23→24/27→28as turns. print_pagination.json itself records the correct sequence; this is not a book-pagination defect.
findings.required_correction: Improve diagnostic labels/layout to show the actual before-turn and after-turn spreads or clearly marked non-facing turn comparisons, while leaving book pagination unchanged.
